gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed World Health Organization (WHO) grade 4 glioma (GBM) or gliosarcoma, IDH wild-type, per WHO 2021 classification

candidate_evidence.quote: Phase I Trial of DNA-PK Inhibitor (PEPOSERTIB ) in Combination With Radiation and Adjuvant Temozolomide
Peposertib may further stop the growth of tumor cells by blocking some of the enzymes needed for cell growth.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Newly Diagnosed MGMT Unmethylated and Recurrent Glioblastoma

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Ability of the investigational drug to cross the blood brain barrier will be tested by measuring concentration of the drug within the blood and the resected brain tumor tissue.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: To determine the ability of Peposertib to cross the blood brain barrier and to evaluate their pharmacodynamic properties in resected tissue.
This will be correlated with biomarkers of deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) damage in brain tumor tissue, blood, and hair follicle.

role_evidence.quote: Phase I Trial of DNA-PK Inhibitor (PEPOSERTIB ) in Combination With Radiation and Adjuvant Temozolomide

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: DNA-PK inhibition, blocking enzymes needed for cell growth and radiosensitising

role_evidence.quote: STAGE I (ADJUVANT): Patients receive temozolomide PO once daily (QD) on days 1-5.
STAGE II (ADJUVANT): Patients receive temozolomide as in Stage I.

source_quote.quote: Documentation of MGMT unmethylated GBM per testing at any Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendment (CLIA) certified laboratory
Histologically confirmed World Health Organization (WHO) grade 4 glioma (GBM) or gliosarcoma, IDH wild-type, per WHO 2021 classification
This will be correlated with biomarkers of deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) damage in brain tumor tissue, blood, and hair follicle.

coder_notes: MGMT unmethylated is required only for the newly diagnosed cohort (recurrent cohort has no MGMT requirement); the registered arms are labelled by stage, not by setting, so arms is left empty. Radiotherapy is a backbone partner in both arms. The pharmacodynamic DNA-damage row is not an eligibility/enrichment biomarker so it does not affect the primary outcome.
